build_berard_model: build a s2t_berard speech-to-text translation model with a bi-LSTM encoder and LSTM decoder
build_berard_encoder: build a BerardEncoder with linear input layers, conv2d layers, and bidirectional LSTM layers
build_lstm_decoder: build an LSTMDecoder with Bahdanau MLP attention for incremental speech-to-text decoding
build_mlp_attention: build an MLPAttention module that computes Bahdanau attention scores between encoder and decoder states
configure_berard_architecture: configure a s2t_berard model architecture with default hyperparameters for speech translation
